# Boze Titanium Manufacturing Center

> Boze Titanium Manufacturing Center (cnc.bozemetal.com) is the specialized titanium CNC machining, additive manufacturing, and precision engineering division of Baoji Boze Metal Products Co., Ltd. (operating under the global brand "Boze CNC Ti"). Located in Baoji ("China's Titanium Valley"), we provide aerospace-grade and medical-grade custom titanium components for global B2B clients.

## Core Engineering & Manufacturing Capabilities

- **Machining Tolerances**: Precision CNC milling and turning with tight tolerances down to ±0.005 mm.
- **Quality Certifications**: AS9100D certified, ISO 9001:2015 compliant, NADCAP accredited processes, AS9102 FAI report capable, and Level 3 PPAP support.
- **Materials Processed**: Full spectrum of commercially pure titanium and aerospace/medical alloys (Grade 1, Grade 2, Grade 4, Grade 5 / Ti-6Al-4V, Grade 9, Grade 23 / Ti-6Al-4V ELI, Grade 6242, Ti-5553, Beta alloys). Also processes stainless steel, aluminum, and nickel-based superalloys.
- **Manufacturing Methods**: 3/4/5-Axis CNC Machining, SLM/DMLS Metal 3D Printing (Additive Manufacturing), Sheet Metal Fabrication (Laser / Waterjet Cutting & TIG/MIG/Orbital Welding), Hot & Cold Forging, Extrusion, Heat Treatment (Vacuum Annealing), EDM (Wire & Ram), and Anodizing / Passivation / PVD / DLC Surface Treatments.
- **Inspection & Metrology**: CMM (Coordinate Measuring Machine) with ±0.001 mm accuracy, OES material verification, X-ray/CT inspection, Ultrasonic Testing (UT), Eddy Current Testing (ECT), tensile/hardness testing, and helium leak testing.
- **Industries Served**: Aerospace & Defense, Medical Devices & Implants, Marine & Subsea, Semiconductor, Energy (Hydrogen, Nuclear), Robotics, and High-Performance Automotive.
- **Facility**: C4 Workshop, North Area of High Tech Auto Parts Business Incubation Base, FengHuang 10th Road, High Tech Development Zone, Baoji City, Shaanxi Province, China 721013.

## All Services & Service Details

- [CNC Machining Services](https://cnc.bozemetal.com/services/cnc-machining): High-precision 3/4/5-axis milling, turning, Swiss-type turning, and Wire EDM for titanium components.
- [Titanium Additive Manufacturing](https://cnc.bozemetal.com/services/additive-manufacturing): SLM / DMLS 3D printing for complex internal geometries, rapid prototyping, and low-volume production.
- [Titanium Fabrication](https://cnc.bozemetal.com/services/fabrication): Precision laser cutting, waterjet cutting, sheet metal forming, TIG/MIG/Orbital welding, and assembly.
- [Surface Treatment](https://cnc.bozemetal.com/services/surface-treatment): Type II/III anodizing (AMS 2488), chemical passivation, micro-blasting, PVD/DLC coating, electropolishing, and shot peening.
- [Titanium Forming & Heavy Manufacturing](https://cnc.bozemetal.com/services/forming): Hot & cold forging, extrusion, bend forming, and ring rolling for large structural components.
- [Heat Treatment & Post-Processing](https://cnc.bozemetal.com/services/heat-treatment): Vacuum annealing (stress relief), vacuum brazing, hot isostatic pressing (HIP), and aging treatment.
- [Inspection & Quality Testing](https://cnc.bozemetal.com/services/inspection): CMM dimensional inspection, UT/ECT/X-ray NDT, tensile/impact testing, metallographic analysis, and cleanroom packaging.
- [Raw Material Preparation](https://cnc.bozemetal.com/services/raw-material): Bar stock cutting, forging conversion, ingot traceability per ASME Section III, and material certification with OES verification.
- [Branded & Custom Packaging](https://cnc.bozemetal.com/services/packaging): Custom laser marking, logo branding, retail-ready packaging, and Class 10/100 cleanroom packaging for medical and semiconductor components.

## Products Catalog

- [All Products](https://cnc.bozemetal.com/products/): Browse hundreds of precision titanium components across all manufacturing categories.
- [CNC Machined Parts](https://cnc.bozemetal.com/products?category=cnc): Impellers, housings, brackets, valve stems, flanges, threaded fasteners, and custom-engineered components.
- [Additively Manufactured Parts](https://cnc.bozemetal.com/products?category=additive): Lightweight lattice structures, organic geometries, medical implants (dental, orthopedic, spinal), and aerospace brackets.
- [Fabricated Assemblies](https://cnc.bozemetal.com/products?category=fabrication): Welded frames, tube assemblies, pressure vessels, heat exchanger components, and subsea hardware.
- [Medical Device Components](https://cnc.bozemetal.com/products?category=medical): Orthopedic implants (hip stems, knee components, bone plates, spinal cages), surgical instruments, dental implants, and MRI-compatible hardware.
- [Aerospace & Defense Components](https://cnc.bozemetal.com/products?category=aerospace): Engine pylon brackets, clevis brackets, compressor blades, hypersonic control surfaces, and missile/rocket motor hardware.

## Full Manufacturing Capabilities Index (445+ capabilities)

- [All Capabilities](https://cnc.bozemetal.com/products/capabilities/): Complete listing of 445+ precision manufacturing capabilities for titanium components.
- [5-Axis CNC Milling](https://cnc.bozemetal.com/products/capabilities/5-axis-cnc-milling-of-aerofoils/): 5-axis simultaneous milling of complex aerofoil profiles with ±0.01 mm tolerance.
- [CNC Turning](https://cnc.bozemetal.com/products/capabilities/cnc-turning-of-valve-stems/): Precision CNC turning of valve stems, ring profiles, and threaded components.
- [Wire EDM](https://cnc.bozemetal.com/products/capabilities/wire-edm-of-thin-shutter-blades-and-aperture-disks/): Wire electrical discharge machining for thin, intricate profiles and hardened materials.
- [CMM Dimensional Inspection](https://cnc.bozemetal.com/products/capabilities/cmm-dimensional-inspection--001mm/): Full 3D CMM metrology with ±0.001 mm measurement accuracy per ISO 10360.
- [Ultrasonic Inspection (UT)](https://cnc.bozemetal.com/products/capabilities/ultrasonic-inspection-ut/): Flaw detection and thickness mapping for critical aerospace and subsea components.
- [X-Ray & CT Inspection](https://cnc.bozemetal.com/products/capabilities/x-ray-ct-inspection/): Non-destructive internal structure analysis for weld integrity and additive parts.
- [Vacuum Annealing](https://cnc.bozemetal.com/products/capabilities/vacuum-annealing/): Stress-relieving heat treatment under argon atmosphere for titanium components.
- [Thread Rolling](https://cnc.bozemetal.com/products/capabilities/thread-rolling-of-all-fasteners/): Cold-formed thread rolling for superior fatigue strength (30-50% improvement vs cut threads).
- [Anodizing (AMS 2488)](https://cnc.bozemetal.com/products/capabilities/anodizing-ams-2488/): Type II and Type III hard anodizing per AMS 2488 for wear resistance and corrosion protection.
- [Laser Cutting](https://cnc.bozemetal.com/products/capabilities/laser-cutting-of-titanium-plate/): Precision fiber laser cutting of titanium sheet and plate up to 25 mm thickness.
- [TIG Welding](https://cnc.bozemetal.com/products/capabilities/tig-welding-of-assemblies/): Manual and orbital TIG welding for titanium assemblies with full inert gas shielding.
- [SLM 3D Printing](https://cnc.bozemetal.com/products/capabilities/slm-3d-printing/): Selective laser melting for complex titanium geometries with full material traceability.
- [Chemical Passivation](https://cnc.bozemetal.com/products/capabilities/cleaning--passivation/): Nitric acid passivation per ASTM A967 for corrosion resistance enhancement.
- [Shot Peening](https://cnc.bozemetal.com/products/capabilities/surface-shot-peening/): Controlled shot peening for compressive residual stress induction and fatigue life improvement.

## Industries Served

- [Aerospace](https://cnc.bozemetal.com/industries/aerospace): AS9100D certified titanium components for airframe, engine, and landing gear applications.
- [Defense & UAV](https://cnc.bozemetal.com/industries/defense): Hypersonic vehicle hardware, missile components, drone frames, and armor plates.
- [Medical Devices](https://cnc.bozemetal.com/industries/medical): ISO 13485 compliant orthopedics, spinal implants, surgical instruments, and dental components.
- [Marine & Subsea](https://cnc.bozemetal.com/industries/marine): Corrosion-resistant titanium components for underwater vehicles, propellers, and seawater systems.
- [Semiconductor](https://cnc.bozemetal.com/industries/semiconductor): High-purity titanium chambers, gas delivery components, and wafer handling hardware.
- [Energy](https://cnc.bozemetal.com/industries/energy): Hydrogen fuel cell components, nuclear power hardware, and oil & gas downhole tools.
- [Industrial Equipment](https://cnc.bozemetal.com/industries/industrial): Custom titanium parts for chemical processing, heat exchangers, and industrial automation.
